description: Typed core/room and capability vectors for protocol version 1 (spec/room.cddl, spec/management.cddl). The top-level vectors are manage-request and manage-response frames carrying room.send, room.read, room.leave, room.invite and capability.request params and room-join-ok, room-members-ok and capability-grant-ok outcomes, round-tripped like any other file. The `room_params` section gives, for each frame, the shape a typed decoder must read it as and the value of every field and the keys of its open tail; a list of frames each breaking one rule of a shape, which a typed decoder must refuse, each naming the valid vector it varies; and the cases of the room-path and hex helpers. Every outcome is written by hand from the spec, never produced by an implementation. Device-ids and tokens are structural bytes.
